title: Shuffled Yard
description: Practice mode's "Random list order" toggle reshuffles every lane's card order on each reload — a fair simulation of a board where insertion order was never a promise. Prove your assertions survive being shuffled.
successCondition: With Practice mode's "Random list order" toggle switched on and a vehicle lane containing at least three shipment cards, a test asserts the presence and correct vehicle-column membership of each shipment by its content (id or origin/destination label), not by its position/index in the lane — the same assertions pass across at least two separate page reloads even though the on-screen order of the cards differs between reloads.
hints: The toggle lives under "Locators" in the Practice mode drawer.
shuffleIfEnabled re-shuffles on every render when the toggle is on, so don't cache a card's index from one reload and reuse it after reloading — always re-locate by content.
